channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Advanced Geology
item.description: Adds new, realistic ores and stones with heavy IOG compatibility

item.title: Fish Breeding
item.description: A patch for my server that allows all fish to be bred with specific pellets for them

item.title: Solaria's Solace Server Tweaks
item.description: A bunch of fixes and additions for the server.

item.title: TURBOJOIN
item.description: (hopefully) speeds up server load time

item.title: TassModFixesTweaks
item.description: A catch all mod for anything that does not fit my other mods - fixing bugs and tweaking mods

item.title: Temporal Relics
item.description: Adds randomized affixes to found equipment, introducing mundane, corrupted, and temporally enhanced

item.title: Temporal Convergence
item.description: Expands the creatures emerging from temporal rifts with new eldritch entities, afflicted automatons,

item.title: Resonator Overhaul
item.description: Per-resonator volume, falloff and looping — saved to the world and audible with Music off.

item.title: Doors, Hatches, & Gates Overhaul
item.description: Auto-opening doors with selectable sounds and configurable hand or lever-only operation.

item.title: Crucible on Forge
item.description: Smelt ore at your forge instead of trekking back to a firepit.

item.title: Walkable Deck (Experimental)
item.description: EXPERIMENTAL - Walk around on Shipwright boat decks while they sail. Requires Shipwright.

item.title: Crucibles Stay Hot
item.description: Crucibles will continue to receive heat when sitting in the output slot of a lit firepit.

item.title: Simple teleporter
item.description: Teleport to your home or any marked location on your map.

item.title: Repair Kits
item.description: Adds multiple repair kit items to the game that can repair ANY item with durability.

item.title: Crucibulum
item.description: Set a crucible in the forge and melt metal where you smith it

item.title: Waypoint Beacon
item.description: Your map knows. Your eyes can too - 3D beacons for waypoints

item.title: Simple Forge Arrows
item.description: Changes the forge values for arrows from 6 to 9 and 9 to 18. Meaning 1 ingot = 9 and 2 ingots = 18.

item.title: WOO Fantasy Additions
item.description: A mod focused on bringing the lore of the Oldwood into Vintage Story.

item.title: Vozzie's Fantasy Races and Classes
item.description: A collection of races, racial traits and classes for the Racial Equality mod by Tomoyuki

item.title: Charcoal Kiln
item.description: Charcoal Kiln adds a permanent and reusable kiln to make your endless batches of charcoal.

item.title: Foundations Lib
item.description: Extends transitionable functionality and makes it more configurable.

item.title: Land Of Estrellas
item.description: The offical modpack of The Land of Estrellas server

item.title: Place it Anywhere
item.description: Place any item as decoration on floors, walls and ceilings. Up to 64 items per cell.

item.title: Better Hoe
item.description: Adds function to create paths with the hoe.

item.title: RespawnInfo
item.description: Adds a command and a small GUI to check your respawn count and coordinates.

item.title: Floral Zones: Mediterranean Region
item.description: Adds plants from the Mediterranean Region to the game.

item.title: Floral Zones: Neozeylandic Region
item.description: Adds plants from the Neozeylandic Region to the game.

item.title: Floral Zones: East Asiatic Region
item.description: Adds plants from the East Asiatic Region to the game.

item.title: Floral Zones: Central Australian Region
item.description: Adds plants from the Central Australian Region to the game.

item.title: Floral Zones: Caribbean Region
item.description: Adds plants from the Caribbean Region to the game.
